Thanks for the flag, Olivia — good question and an easy source of confusion this week. Quick clarification:

- The US switches to Daylight Saving Time on Sun, Mar 9, 2025, which means from March 9 onwards our Eastern time is EDT (UTC-4).
- Continental Europe (CET → CEST) does not switch until Sun, Mar 30, 2025 (UTC+1 → UTC+2).

That means during the week of Mar 10–29 there is a 5-hour difference between EDT and CET (EDT = UTC-4, CET = UTC+1), so: 10:00 AM EDT = 15:00 CET. After Mar 30 the same 10:00 AM EDT would map to 16:00 CEST.

To avoid ambiguity, we can do either:
1) Move the demo to 11:00 AM ET on Mon Mar 17 (that will be 16:00 CET for your team), or
2) Keep 10:00 AM ET and we will record the session and follow up if anyone can't make it.

Option 1 is probably better so your Berlin engineers can join live at 16:00 local. I've attached an updated calendar invite (acme-demo-updated.ics) for 11:00 AM ET / 16:00 CET — Vanessa, can you confirm before I send the updated invite?

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
